title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. going for haj will pray qasr or as muqeem? 8796 views Q. I wish to take my mother and wife for HAJJ . But I have some business problems and creditors to pay ( I am writing my problems below in detail) so I am not sure if MY HAJJ WILL BE IN ORDER . I am doing business in the family but due to some disputes our business is on closure and we have bank interest and creditors to pay. I want to settle all the creditors by selling our land to avoid the WRATH OF ALLAH SUBHANAHO TAALAH , but my other associates are not ready for this. As we are all blaming each other for the problems and nobody is interested in settling the business creditors / bank as they all want some money for themselves before they are ready to settle the accounts. The situation is not improving and I want to take my mother and wife for HAJJ with my own personal busines money . Can you please advice, in the light of the Shariat , am I allowed to perform the HAJJ in this situation and will it be in order ? May Allah give you the JAZAA for helping me in this matter. 1926 views Q. UMRAH IN LAST 10 DAYS OF RAMADHAN 2250 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 31118 Country: India Title: I am a retd.Govt.(state-UP)servant.I intending to holly journey of haj-2011. Question: I am a retd.Govt.(state-UP)servant.I intending to holly journey of haj-2011. My question is this that Ihave two sons and two daughters,out of which one son and daughters had married.In the yr.2008 my daughters got divorced due to some reasons.My soenns well to do.. Can I performed my poius haj jouerny,I am vehmently waiting your suggestion in the light of islamic ethis. Answer ID: 31118 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 613/613/M=1432) You do perform the holy journey of hajj. May Almighty Allah give firmness in your intention and bless you with hajj mabroor (accepted). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
